title: BOX OF VINTAGE COMICS INCLUDIN...
reason: Bagged Classics Illustrated and 1980s Marvel and DC comics, no key issue confirmed, but worth flipping through at the viewing for numbers and condition.
findings: One photo of a loose pile of about 11 bagged comics (only the top of the box is shown). Identified from covers: several Classics Illustrated with the yellow banner 'Featuring Stories by the World's Greatest Authors' (The Count of Monte Cristo, Silas Marner, The Queen's Necklace, The Man Without a Country, and at least two more partly hidden), The Amazing Spider-Man (Marvel, cover with a flaming skeleton, issue number illegible), Moon Knight (Marvel, white silhouette on a red sun, issue number illegible), All-Star Squadron (DC, newsstand copy with barcode, 1980s), and one more with a red masthead ending in ROLL. The title claim of vintage comics including Spider-Man is supported. No issue numbers, years or cover prices are legible, so no key issue can be confirmed.
condition: Each comic is in a clear bag; covers look slightly toned and creased at the edges. Grading is not possible from the photo.
rescore_note: About 11 bagged comics seen (several yellow-banner Classics Illustrated, 1980s newsstand Amazing Spider-Man, Moon Knight, All-Star Squadron and a few partly hidden titles), no issue numbers legible and no key issue confirmed, covers toned and creased; ordinary bundle, judged $30 to $80 band unless the rest of the box is better.
